questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, drivers can park there for only a limited time.
questions.explanation: Painted curbs show parking rules. A green curb means you can park for a limited time. A nearby sign will tell you how long.

questions.question: You may drive in a High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) lane if:

options.text: You are driving faster than the flow of traffic.
You are driving more slowly than the flow of traffic.

questions.explanation: Some highways have special lanes for vehicles with multiple passengers. These HOV lanes are marked with signs and diamond symbols on the road.

questions.question: Drive below the posted speed limit when:

options.text: Anything makes conditions less than perfect.
Entering a highway where there are other cars.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Anything makes conditions less than perfect.
questions.explanation: Drive below the speed limit when the road is wet or slippery, when visibility is poor, or when conditions are not ideal. You can be ticketed for speeding even if you stay within the posted limit when conditions are unsafe.

questions.question: When changing lanes you should not:

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Give a turn signal to signal your intentions.
Check for other drivers who may be moving into the same lane as you.
Use your cell phone to contact the police to determine if the road ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to contact the police to determine if the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors for traffic behind you. Use your turn signal to tell other drivers. Look for drivers moving into the same lane. Do not use your cell phone while driving.

questions.question: Drinking coffee after drinking alcohol:

options.text: Cancels the effect of the alcohol.
Has no effect on blood alcohol concentration.

questions.correctAnswerText: Has no effect on blood alcohol concentration.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not lower your blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it cannot make you sober or change your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, finish the turn in:

options.text: The lane closest to your previous lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane closest to your original lane. This is the safest way to change lanes.

questions.question: A railroad crossbuck sign should be treated the same as a yield sign.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossbuck sign is like a yield sign. You must yield to any trains and railroad equipment.

questions.question: How fast you drive does not affect the distance your vehicle travels after you brake to come to a stop.
questions.explanation: As your speed increases, the distance needed to stop also increases. Stay far behind the vehicle in front of you when driving at high speeds.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver is heading toward you in your lane, you should:

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and accelerate.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in the center of your lane, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: Honk to get attention. If the other driver does not move, steer right. Do not steer left because the other driver might correct at the last moment. Brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the impact.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are usually yellow (or orange in work areas). They warn you that something hazardous is ahead or that special rules apply.

questions.question: At a stop sign, what should you do after stopping?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for tailgating cars.
Move when the car ahead moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because cars from the left are closer to you. Then look right. Finally, look left again in case you missed a vehicle.

questions.question: At night, another vehicle is coming toward you. How should your headlights be set?

options.text: High or low beam — either is fine.

questions.explanation: Do not use high beams when another vehicle is approaching or when you are following another car at night. Use low beams to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions per mile. You need to focus completely on driving. Any extra task is dangerous.

questions.question: You are in traffic crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates. What should you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You can pass slower drivers while crossing.
Make sure your vehicle can cross all the way without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle can cross all the way without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before entering the tracks, check that you have enough room to get completely across. Never try to pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: What color are road markings that separate traffic going in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines in the center of the road separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: If a crossing guard is directing traffic in a school zone, you must:

options.text: Do what other cars do, even if it ignores the guard.
Assume the guard should not be there.
Drive as you would without children present.

questions.explanation: Follow directions from crossing guards, signs, and police in school zones. Always drive carefully in school areas.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the center mean?
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: You want to turn left at a green light, but oncoming traffic is heavy. What should you do?

options.text: Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Turn because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the middle of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: You can enter the intersection on a green light to prepare for your left turn. Wait in the center for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: When can you cross solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass traffic moving the same direction.

questions.explanation: Broken lines can be crossed, but solid lines cannot. You can cross solid yellow lines only when turning.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic going in the same direction. You may cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign on a yellow panel means your lane goes off the road to form a ramp. You can change lanes to go through the interchange, or you must exit the highway.

questions.question: You do not have to stop for a school bus with flashing red lights on a private road.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has flashing red lights and its stop arm out, you must stop. This law applies on both public and private roads.

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road. What should you do?

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the pavement.
Speed up and steer back onto the pavement gradually.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Gently apply the brakes to slow down. Turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently apply the brakes to slow down. Turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement safely.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, keep them off the pavement and gently apply the brakes to slow down. When you reach a safe speed, turn the steering wheel to return to the pavement. Do not sharply turn the steering wheel to force your vehicle back.

questions.question: When you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If another driver is threatening you or driving dangerously, stay calm and create distance. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: When you approach a railroad crossing warning sign, you should:

options.text: Be ready to drive faster than the train.
Be prepared to stop if a train is nearby.
Look for a way around any lowered gates.
Assume no trains are nearby and continue driving normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if a train is nearby.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs warn you that a train might be coming. Obey all warning signs and never go around barriers or ignore the sign.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You must have all three documents in your vehicle when driving.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic signal, you must:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop and yield to traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe. At a railroad crossing, flashing red lights mean a train is approaching. Wait until the lights stop flashing and all warning devices are off before crossing.

questions.question: You may drive across a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You may cross them to pass if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When you see other drivers acting or reacting in anger, you should:
questions.explanation: When other drivers are angry, distance yourself from the situation. Avoid eye contact and avoid gestures that could provoke them. Slow down, move over, or do whatever you safely can to stay out of danger.
